items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is Johnny Cottrell. Oh yeah, I know Johnny Cottrell. I see him once every few years.

ctx.x: I was talking about it. Willie Guitart live on Music Street and played bass. And this was the leader, Bobby Williams, Bobby Willow. He played the banjo. You know the stuff? You know the music? I've heard of him, but I've never met him.
This is Johnny Cottrell. Oh yeah, I know Johnny Cottrell. I see him once every few years. And the tuba player, Truth Upon.
